description.p: A writing app. While you write, it's a quiet page: no marks, the rest of the draft dimmed. When you edit, it keeps every version of a word, sentence or paragraph where it belongs: read the next version in place, and choose later, with the real sentence around it.

ul.li: Alternatives: any span can hold several versions
Cuts: what you cut is kept, with its place
Comments in the margin, never in the final text
Zen writing, private mode, themes and typewriter scrolling

description.p: Everything is saved in one Markdown file that any other editor can still open. AI is optional, and it never rewrites your text.
